description: This file handles the process of sending emails to contacts, leads, or accounts based on a custom view in the vtiger CRM. It retrieves email details from various modules, constructs email messages, and sends them via SMTP, incorporating database queries and email configuration.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: Class for handling email sending via SMTP, used to compose and send emails.

methods.name: SendMailtoCustomView
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email to a specified address with given subject and content, using SMTP server configuration.
